parameters.query: UPDATE candidates SET stage=$2::text||'_booking',recruiter_event_id=CASE WHEN $2::text='recruiter' THEN $3 ELSE recruiter_event_id END,technical_event_id=CASE WHEN $2::text='technical' THEN $3 ELSE technical_event_id END,final_event_id=CASE WHEN $2::text='final' THEN $3 ELSE final_event_id END,updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=$1 AND stage=$4 AND updated_at::text=$5 AND ((stage=ANY($6::text[]) AND COALESCE(CASE $2::text WHEN 'recruiter' THEN recruiter_event_id WHEN 'technical' THEN technical_event_id WHEN 'final' THEN final_event_id END,'')='') OR (stage=$2::text||'_booking' AND CASE $2::text WHEN 'recruiter' THEN recruiter_event_id WHEN 'technical' THEN technical_event_id WHEN 'final' THEN final_event_id END=$3)) RETURNING id,updated_at::text AS record_version

parameters.query:
WITH completed AS (
UPDATE candidates SET stage=$2::text||'_scheduled',updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=$1 AND stage IN ($2::text||'_booking',$2::text||'_scheduled') AND CASE $2::text WHEN 'recruiter' THEN recruiter_event_id WHEN 'technical' THEN technical_event_id WHEN 'final' THEN final_event_id END=$3 AND updated_at::text=$4 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hr_interview_sessions WHERE candidate_id=$1 AND interview_type=$2::text AND event_id=$3 AND NOT (reviewer_emails @> $8::text[] AND reviewer_emails <@ $8::text[])) RETURNING id,$2::text AS interview_type,$5::boolean AS already_booked,$6::text AS start,$7::text AS end
), recorded AS (
 INSERT INTO hr_interview_sessions (candidate_id,interview_type,event_id,reviewer_emails)
 SELECT id,$2::text,$3,$8::text[] FROM completed
 ON CONFLICT (candidate_id,interview_type,event_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING candidate_id
)
SELECT completed.* FROM completed WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recorded)
 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hr_interview_sessions WHERE candidate_id=$1 AND interview_type=$2::text AND event_id=$3 AND reviewer_emails @> $8::text[] AND reviewer_emails <@ $8::text[])
